title: Prophecies, pressure and a Lombardi Trophy: Inside the Seahawks' Super Bowl run

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Prophecies, pressure and a Lombardi Trophy: Inside the Seahawks' Super Bowl run
sources.description: An inside account from the field, the locker room and the long night that followed as Seattle's defense, Sam Darnold's steady postseason and Kenneth Walker III's historic MVP performance sealed the franchise's second title.
